description: Implementation of the SemWaiter class for semaphore-based thread synchronization in the Abseil library, including methods for waiting with timeout, posting, and internal semaphore handling.

classes.name: SemWaiter
classes.description: A class that manages semaphore-based waiting with support for timed waits and wakeup notifications.

methods.name: SemWaiter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the semaphore and wakeup counter.

methods.name: TimedWait
methods.description: Performs a timed wait on the semaphore, using platform-specific functions.

methods.name: Wait
methods.description: Waits for a wakeup or timeout, handling spurious wakeups and signals.

methods.name: Post
methods.description: Posts a wakeup signal to the semaphore.

methods.name: Poke
methods.description: Wakes a waiting thread by posting to the semaphore.
